backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, and various typed entities for images, services, contact info, and themes.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking long-description UI updates to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of high-level summaries for all frontend files describing their functionality and UI roles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app root and main entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app layout applying background themes and rendering all primary sections including admin panel and profile setup.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin interface for editing contact info and customizing background themes with color, pattern, and intensity settings.
frontend/src/components/Contact.tsx: Contact section displaying business info and allowing validated customer photo uploads with preview and progress tracking.
Component for displaying and managing featured gallery images with upload, edit, and aspect‑ratio processing support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders site footer with branding, contact details, and social media links using fetched contact info.
frontend/src/components/GalleryDisplay.t: Displays gallery images with admin editing and navigation to a full gallery management page.
frontend/src/components/GalleryManagemen: Admin page for uploading, editing, replacing, and deleting gallery images with aspect‑ratio processing.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with navigation, scroll behavior, mobile drawer, and gallery page toggle events.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Displays the main hero section with dynamic hero image loading, scroll navigation, and an optional admin editor toggle.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerEditor: Provides a dialog for admins to upload, preview, process, and save hero banner images with aspect‑ratio options.
frontend/src/components/ImageGallery.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an image gallery component.
frontend/src/components/ImageUpload.tsx: Empty placeholder file for an image upload component.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with status handling and query cache clearing.
Empty placeholder file for an order cart dialog component.
Empty placeholder file for an order form dialog component.
frontend/src/components/Pricing.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a pricing component.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Shows a dialog prompting users to enter and save their name and phone number via a profile‑save mutation.
frontend/src/components/Services.tsx: Empty placeholder file for a services component.
frontend/src/components/ServicesWithPric: Manages service listings with create, update, delete, and image upload flows, supporting both online and store subcategory services.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, status tracking, and persisted identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin status, and gallery images via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for colors, gradients, and theming in light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/imageProcessor.ts: Implements image resizing, cropping, and compression with selectable aspect ratios and outputs processed image data.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers and mounts the root component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters and session-persisted values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s metadata, feature list, and descriptions of authentication, RBAC, user profiles, public services, and admin management capabilities for the Ikizahra Laundry web app. Functions as the canonical record of existing features and system behavior.
